title: W9 F4 -- Re-record the Prose check popover height and stop the one-frame invisible context menu (REVIEW.md A1, A5)
description: Owner approved both on 2026-11-11 ('Yes re record and fix the menu'). Follow work orders A1 and A5 in docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/REVIEW.md exactly. A1: in tests/fixtures/popover-baseline-rects.json change ONLY the 'Prose check' height from 232 to 146; nothing else in the file. A5: in src/components/ContextMenu.tsx near line 145 change data-animate={viaKeyboard ? undefined : ""} to data-animate={viaKeyboard || window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches ? undefined : ""}; nothing else. No full build by this task: verify on the dev server only: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1449 npx playwright test tests/sidebar-context-menu.spec.ts --repeat-each 10 --trace off --output test-results/F4 (all pass) and PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1449 npx playwright test tests/popover-bounds.spec.ts tests/motion.spec.ts --trace off --output test-results/F4b (all pass); npx tsc -b. The built-app proof is done afterwards by the validation rerun. Write notes/F4.md. No commits.

review.note: Approved on the diff only (agent-23c2; no Playwright run, as the coordinator ordered while the validation runner holds the suite). Fixture diff is exactly one line: Prose check height 232->146 (A1). ContextMenu.tsx diff is exactly the A5 one-liner at :145. Reasoning: Reduce Motion OFF -> matchMedia false -> pointer open still gets data-animate="", so the opacity/transform transition runs as before; keyboard open -> viaKeyboard true -> unset, as before. Reduce Motion ON + pointer -> no data-animate, so context-menu.css:23-26 never applies opacity 0 and the menu is visible on its first frame; data-shown still arrives one rAF later, which is harmless. The system media query is the app's only Reduce Motion source (motion.ts prefersReducedMotion uses the same query), so this is consistent; it is read at render, which is fine for a short-lived menu. npx tsc -b exit 0. Fail-first is weak (race did not reproduce before; admitted). BUILT-APP RERUN MUST CONFIRM: popover-bounds 'toolbar popovers keep their recorded untouched-tree placement' passes on every repeat (it passed 1 of 3 against the OLD 232 baseline in my T280 run, so the Prose check height may vary; use --repeat-each 5 or more and watch for a 232-ish reading); sidebar-context-menu:319 'Reduce Motion: a pointer-opened menu is instant' passes under --repeat-each 10; and the pointer-animation tests in sidebar-context-menu and motion stay green.
